t.zh: 到这里，折起来的介词短语都挂在名词上，说明“什么样的”“谁的”，这样的修饰成分叫<wiki-ref to="attributive"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: So far every folded phrase has hung on a noun, telling what kind or whose; such a modifier is an <wiki-ref to="attributive"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 介词短语也可以说明动作本身：在哪里做、用什么做、什么时候做。这时它挂在谓语的动词上，叫<wiki-ref to="adverbial"></wiki-ref>。同一个介词短语挂在哪，只能看意思。
t.en: A prepositional phrase can also tell about the action itself: where, with what, when it is done. Then it hangs on the verb, and is an <wiki-ref to="adverbial"></wiki-ref>. Where a phrase hangs is told only by the meaning.

title.zh: We train the model on a single GPU.
title.en: We train the model on a single GPU.

body.zh: on a single GPU 挂在 train 上：在一块 GPU 上训练模型。它紧跟着 the model，说明的却是动作。
body.en: on a single GPU hangs on train: the training happens on one GPU. It follows the model but tells about the action.

note.zh: 说明“什么样的”挂名词，说明“在哪、怎么做”挂动词。
note.en: What kind: on the noun. Where or how: on the verb.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold the modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: 在一块 GPU 上的，是模型，还是训练这件事？
hint.en: What is on a single GPU: the model, or the training?

tasks.sentence: We train the model on a single GPU.

model.zh: 挂在 model 上，意思是“装在一块 GPU 上的那个模型”。这里说的是训练在一块 GPU 上进行。
model.en: Hung on model, it means the model that sits on one GPU. What happens on one GPU here is the training.
